_meta.description: Machine-readable classical timing dictums by event, verse-level. Status: verse=located in primary text; commentary=late-classic/commentarial; popular=no classical verse found (do NOT test as scripture). testable: yes/partial/no against our corpus (D1 signs+houses, D9, recomputed longitudes, MD+AD windows, dated events).

meta_rules.rule: Dasha results from lord's nature, placement+state, strength; then lordship; then association
Dasha tone graded by dignity: exalt full, trine 3/4, own 1/2, friend 1/4, enemy little, debilitated zero; combust = debilitated; lord in 6/8/12 adverse

12-lord dasha table: L1 wellbeing, L2 death-risk, L4 home/land, L5 learning+children, L6 disease, L7 spouse-trouble+death-risk, L8 death+money-loss, L9 gains/fame, L10 government honours, L11 obstructed gains, L12 suffering
AD lord counted FROM the MD lord: kendra/trikona/11 good, 6/8/12 sorrow; AD lord gives the bhava-results of its house from the MD lord
meta_rules.note: untested frame in our runs so far

meta_rules.rule: AD of the MD lord's enemy = death-like time
Benefic AD lord unconnected with malefic MD lord gives evil anyway; connected gives mixed; planets associated with MD lord reproduce its results in their ADs
Phase rule: 1st/2nd/3rd drekkana of sign -> results at start/middle/end of dasha; retrograde reversed. Variants JP 18.82 (house/sign/aspect thirds), PD 20.33 (udaya)
Dasha-transit samanvaya: dasha lord's transit nourishes the transited house if natal-strong; trigger when transit Sun/Jupiter enter dasha lord's exalt/own sign; Moon-from-dasha-lord gates
Two lordships: contradictory results cancel, different both obtain; strength full/half/quarter; moolatrikona sign dominates; first sign fruits in first half of dasha
Rahu/Ketu give results of the planet they conjoin; trouble especially at dasha-end
Planet at sign-junction: its dasha gives grief/disease; at bhava-sandhi gives nothing

marriage.rule: Marriage in dasha of occupant/aspector/lord of 7H
Strong 7H -> marriage in 7L dasha; WEAK 7L dasha -> separation from wife (divorce timing)
Marriage in dasha of strongest of {rasi-dispositor(7L), navamsa-dispositor(7L), Venus, Moon}, with Jupiter transit trine to 7L sign/navamsa
Also dashas of: dispositor of Venus-joined 7th sign; dispositor of 2L's sign; 10L; 8L; planet CONJUNCT 7L; occupant of 7H
BPHS-stream: marriage in specific benefic MD/AD pairs gated by dignity/position conditions (18 pairs; self-marriage: Sun-Jup 52.32, Sun-Ven 52.65, Sat-Ven 57.24, Merc-Moon 58.26, Rahu-Ven PD 21.35)
In BPHS the 7L dasha is a MARAKA (distress to wife, death-risk) - 7L-marriage rule is Phaladeepika/JP stream; test streams separately
13 fixed-age yogas -> marriage at specific ages 5-33 (e.g. Venus 7th-from-Moon + Saturn 7th-from-Venus -> 18)
Transit triggers: Venus/7L trine to 1L sign-navamsa; 1L over 7H sign; Jupiter over 7L/Venus house
Early marriage: 1L near 7L; benefic near 1L/7L; strong 7L in 2H
Within-dasha tempo: benefic in benefic sign -> start; benefic in malefic sign -> middle; malefic in malefic sign -> end
Jaimini: DK = spouse karaka; UL afflicted -> denial unless benefic relief; 2nd-from-UL = spouse-loss point; Sat+Rahu there -> loss/divorce; chara-dasha of UL/A7/DK signs
Delay/denial: 7H/7L hemmed/debilitated/COMBUST -> deprived of wife; Saturn in female 7H -> old without marriage; Mars+Saturn in 7th-from-Venus AND 7th-from-Moon -> wifeless
Plurality/remarriage: dual-sign 7L+Venus -> two wives; benefics+malefics in female 7H -> remarriage; exalted A7 lord -> second marriage
Widowhood in the dasha of the navamsa-dispositor of the 8L (malefic in 8H); Mars in female 7H -> early widowhood; spouse-death age table; Mars-6/Rahu-7/Saturn-8 chain
Mangal dosha verse NOT in any primary classic (Agastya Samhita / Manasagari / Deva Keralam attributions); classical core = Mars in female 7H harms spouse

career_wealth.rule: 10L dasha -> recognition/awards from government, per 10L dignity & house
Karmajiva: profession from 10th from Lagna/Moon/Sun; livelihood = lord of navamsa occupied by 10L (strongest reference)
Raja-yoga formation: kendra x trikona sambandha; yogakaraka; 9L+10L Dharma-Karmadhipati

Raja-yoga TIMING: fruits in dashas of yoga-participants; begins in yogakaraka MD, continues in 3/6/11-lord ADs; planets conjunct yogakaraka give it in their ADs; kendra-lord MD x trikona-lord AD; often BEGINS in maraka bhuktis
'Fructifies in dasha of the stronger' - not BPHS; actual: UK 5.28.5-29.5 + BPHS 39.5 strength-proportionality
1-10 exchange -> rajya-labha in the dashas of L1 and L10 (explicit dasha verse); likewise 1-9
25 MD/AD pairs with rajya-labha/position/wealth + exact gating conditions (table in research file)
Position loss: AD 6/8/12 from MD lord; weak-L10 dasha -> failure/exile/loss of honour; afflicted Sun dasha -> punishment/exile
Wealth: L5/L9 + planets conjunct them give wealth in their dashas; wealth-LOSS in dashas of planets joined to L6/L8/L12 without trine-lord aspect; L8 dasha -> financial loss
Dashas of 3/6/11 lords & maraka-connected planets unfavourable; dusthana-lord dashas redeemed by trikona-lord association; viparita exception
Dasha of planet IN the 10th -> ruling powers/fame; malefic 10th/12th from MD lord in its AD -> defame/loss
Raja-yoga bhanga gates (fallen planets, weak Moon, Sun at Libra 10deg)

death_longevity.rule: Maraka houses 2 & 7 (2nd stronger); killer set = lords + malefic occupants + malefics joined to lords; death in their MD/AD gated by ayus band
Fallback ladder: 12L -> benefic related to 12L -> 8L -> pure malefic
Maraka does not kill in benefic bhuktis even if related; kills in malefic bhuktis even if unrelated
Saturn ill-disposed + related to maraka kills first of all
Jupiter/Venus as kendra-lords = powerful marakas (LAGHU PARASHARI not BPHS); Venus-Saturn AD exchange-of-results
Rahu/Ketu in 1/7/8/12 or related to maraka lords acquire killing power
6L dasha can kill; ADs of 6/8/12 lords; AD lord owning 2&7 -> apamrityu (severity per planet: Merc/Sat worst, Moon mildest)
Seven chhidra grahas (8L, occupant/aspector of 8H, 22nd-drekkana lord, planet w/ 8L, 64th-navamsa-from-Moon lord, atisatru of 8L): death in dasha of the strongest
Ayurdaya three-pairs (1L/8L, Sat/Moon, Lagna/Hora-Lagna) x sign-quality -> alpa/madhya/purna bands; year caps; Saturn declension
Marakas OF a bhava (its 2nd & 7th) time death of that relative (father 9th, mother 4th, spouse 7th)
death_longevity.citation: UK kanda IV-V; PD bhava rule

death_longevity.rule: Illness: weak-8L dasha -> sickness/death; malefics in 6/8/12 from any bhava destroy it; 6H/8H occupant disease signatures

children.rule: Childbirth in dashas/ADs of occupants of 5H, aspectors of 5H, 5L (+ L1, L7, Jupiter)
children.note: no clean childbirth event class in corpus

children.rule: Child in dasha/AD of strong 5L or Jupiter OR of the lords of the signs/navamsas they occupy
5th from Jupiter/Moon/Lagna; son in dasha-bhukti of its lord; nakshatra-dasha of 5L+7L summed longitudes
BPHS: 5L dasha -> child-happiness; Venus AD in Sun MD -> birth of son; AD kendra/kona from MD lord in Jup MD -> putra-labha
Jupiter transit over trines of 5L sign/navamsa -> birth of son
Promise/denial: 5L in 6/8/12 -> childless; triple-frame affliction -> no children; adoption yogas; curse apparatus; Beeja/Kshetra-sphuta parity
Fixed-age verses: son at 30/32-33/36/40; child-death at 32; grief at 56
D7 governs children (BPHS 7.2); 'D7-lord dasha' timing = derived tradition, no verse

education.rule: Mercury AD in Saturn MD (kendra/trikona) -> vidya-labha; Mercury MD -> education success; Jup/Jup -> learning; afflicted Mercury sub-periods -> vidya-hani
4L = learning; Mercury=vidya, Jupiter=jnana karakas; 12L in 5th -> bereft of learning

travel_foreign.rule: House anchors: 7th = road travel, 9th = pilgrimage, 10th = pravasa (residence away). 12th = foreign settlement NOT in BPHS ch.11
Rahu dasha -> honor from foreign (Yavana) lord; Saturn in 6/8/12 -> wandering abroad; Ketu -> journeys/banishment
AD kendra/kona/3/11 from MD lord -> pilgrimage/honor abroad; 6/8/12 -> displacement; Saturn AD in Rahu MD -> residence in distant land
All planets in movable signs (Rajju) -> dwelling in foreign lands
Modern package '12L+9L+7L+Rahu = foreign settlement' - components classical, package modern
